findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document access
findings.body: When `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, `canReadDocument` now still returns `true`. Replacing the tenant equality check with an unconditional grant allows cross-tenant document access and bypasses the existing isolation boundary.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document access
findings.body:
Every call now succeeds, so a user whose `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant` can read another tenant’s document, bypassing tenant isolation.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant equality enforcement
findings.body:
The authorization guard now permits every read. Any caller checking a user from tenant A against a document from tenant B receives `true`, enabling cross-tenant document disclosure and completely bypassing the prior isolation boundary.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
